messages:
alex: Quick experiment proposal: add a preflight/circuit for embeddings ingress to catch oversized mixed-dim payloads before they hit runtime. want console hooks for canary.

mira: which failures are we avoiding? OOMs, 413s, noisy 500s?

alex: all three. current pattern: mixed dims blow up the splitter memory, runtime 500/oom, logs too noisy to trace per-tenant.

jon: suggest two-stage behavior: soft-fail (warn + advice) then hard-fail only when thresholds exceeded or after retries. less disruptive.

mira: we'll need dim-profile and total_bytes in telemetry to correlate with SRE graphs.

alex: plan: preflight emits `embed.preflight.{ok,soft_fail,hard_fail}` with tags: tenant_id, dims_serialized (e.g. "768|1024"), dim_count, total_bytes, route_variant, preflight_version. soft_fail returns 202 + `x-embed-advice: split-suggested`. hard_fail => 413.

sophie: console: can we have a small per-route panel showing preflight outcomes and a dims vs bytes heatmap? prefer no extra retention.

luis: doable via ingest rollups. we'll serialize dims as pipe-delimited and store dim_count. compute percentiles at ingest to keep costs down.

jon: rollout config: `ingress.safeguard.v1` per route, `mode: warn|enforce|off`, thresholds `{bytes: 5MB, dims: 2048, vector_count: 64}`. default warn on canary.

alex: rollout plan: warn in canary 1w, enforce for 2% traffic, escalate if stable. add canary metrics for false positives.

mira: include `dim_signature` hash to group similar mixed-dim patterns for debugging.

sophie: console: show signatures as hover and provide leaderboard per tenant.

luis: telemetry note: don't index arrays. use stringified dims and cap sample length (first 50 dims) and set `dims_truncated` flag to true when truncated.

jon: preflight should be cheap: quick header + sample check sync, expensive ops async. ensure <1ms median and watch P99.

alex: prototype config pushed to ingress repo and I'll open a console PR once events flow.

deploy-bot: Deployment queued: ingress/safeguard-v1 -> canary cluster. started at 1718234700.

alex: I'll DM staging grafana access. thanks everyone. :+1:
